INSERT INTO tb_drafting_work_category ( tenant_id, drafting_work_category_group_id, cata_type_code, code_name, view_seq, reg_term, reviewer_id, approver_id, cata_code, use_at, delete_status, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{categoryGroupId}, #{divisionCode}, #{divisionName}, 0, #{cycle}, #{reviewerId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{approverId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, (SELECT cata_code FROM tb_drafting_work_category_group WHERE drafting_work_category_group_id = #{categoryGroupId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} LIMIT 1), #{useAt}, 'N', #{createdBy, jdbcType=BIGINT}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{updatedBy, jdbcType=BIGINT}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) RETURNING drafting_work_category_id
